gen-tourney-gf-gidole: Stretched, stubby and loud. Tourney spaces its heavy capitals wide, and Gidole follows in thin, neon-tube lines with open terminals, so the loudness has somewhere quiet to land.
gen-tourney-gf-golos-text: Golos Text fills its line with a tall x-height and a widely parted s, friendly and modern. And Tourney, cut at one width and tracked far apart, gives that sans-serif a loud, athletic header to lean against.
gen-tourney-gf-hedvig-letters-sans: Hedvig Letters Sans reads as approachable, its small letters nearly capital height and each c left with a generous gap. Tourney's wide, bulky shapes sit above it as the loud half.
gen-tourney-gf-heebo: Chunky, wide and sporty. Tourney keeps its lines uniform and its small letters oversized, and Heebo, a sans with a tall central band and curves that stop short, does the quieter work of carrying the text.
gen-tourney-gf-hind-guntur: Tourney stretches every word wide, in bulky strokes of one width. Hind Guntur, a plain sans with tall stamped-metal lowercase and wide gaps where curves meet stems, keeps a long passage moving without a thick-thin wobble.
gen-tourney-gf-hind-madurai: Approachable describes Hind Madurai, whose lowercase fills the line like capitals and whose s curves open wide at both ends. Tourney shouts with stretched, bulky letters; the sans-serif just keeps talking.
gen-tourney-gf-hind-mysuru: Tourney's oversized small letters and wide tracking make it unmistakable. Yet Hind Mysuru, a sans with lowercase pressing toward ascender height and no calligraphic thinning, sits beneath it like a steady supporting voice.
gen-tourney-gf-hind-siliguri: Hind Siliguri hums along at constant line weight, its rounds gapped like a cracked bangle. But Tourney, wide-tracked and stocky, makes it feel almost polite, a sans-serif speaking after a shout.
gen-tourney-gf-hind-vadodara: Broad, blocky and built for speed. Tourney's stretched words carry the attitude, while Hind Vadodara, a sans with spacious terminal gaps and tall-bowled e and a, lets the text breathe underneath.
gen-tourney-gf-huninn: Wide, hefty and sporty, Tourney leads with oversized small letters. Its strength is sheer presence, whereas Huninn, a plain sans with open s terminals and crossbars as fat as its stems, simply stays readable.
